parrafo.es: Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry construye gabinetes, cocinas, closets y soluciones de garage a medida en Westchester y el resto de Miami. Cada pieza se mide, se construye y se instala a mano, con el mismo cuidado que refleja nuestra calificación de 5.0 en Google.
parrafo.en: Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry builds custom cabinets, kitchens, closets and garage storage across Westchester and the rest of Miami. Every piece is measured, built and installed by hand, the same care behind our 5.0 rating on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Custom kitchen cabinetry built by Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry, finished with stainless appliances

parrafo_1.es: Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry lo lleva Roilán, un carpintero de Westchester que diseña y construye cada proyecto con sus propias manos: desde marcos a medida para hornos empotrados hasta cocinas, closets y sistemas de garage completos.
parrafo_1.en: Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry is run by Roilán, a Westchester-based carpenter who designs and builds every project himself, from custom oven surrounds to full kitchens, closets and garage systems.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes repiten lo mismo: comunicación clara, precios justos y un área de trabajo que queda limpia al terminar. Esa es la carpintería detrás del nombre de Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry.
parrafo_2.en: Clients mention the same things again and again: clear communication, fair pricing and a job site left clean when the work is done. That is the kind of carpentry Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry builds its name on.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas (cocina, closet, garage o una pieza a medida) y coordinamos una visita para medir.
texto.en: Tell us what you need (a kitchen, closet, garage or a custom piece) and we set up a time to measure.

texto.es: Cada proyecto se mide en sitio y se cotiza según el diseño y el material, sin sorpresas en el precio.
texto.en: Every project is measured on site and quoted based on design and material, no surprises on price.

texto.es: Cada pieza se construye y se instala con atención al detalle, cuidando que encaje exacto en tu espacio.
texto.en: Every piece is built and installed with attention to detail, made to fit your space exactly.

texto.es: Terminamos dejando el área de trabajo limpia, tal como la encontramos.
texto.en: We finish by leaving the work area clean, just the way we found it.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el diseño y el material. Escríbenos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on design and material. Message us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Diseñamos y construimos gabinetes de cocina y marcos a medida para hornos empotrados, ajustados exacto a tu espacio.
texto.en: We design and build kitchen cabinets and custom surrounds for built-in ovens, fitted exactly to your space.

texto.es: Sistemas de closet con iluminación integrada, construidos a la medida de tu cuarto.
texto.en: Closet systems with integrated lighting, built to the exact measurements of your room.

texto.es: Gabinetes de garage que convierten un espacio desordenado en uno funcional y organizado.
texto.en: Built-in garage cabinets that turn a cluttered space into an organized, functional one.

texto.es: Desde un buzón de madera hasta un carrito móvil a medida: si lo puedes dibujar, lo construimos en madera.
texto.en: From a wood mailbox to a custom mobile cart: if you can sketch it, we can build it in wood.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Escríbenos igual: la carpintería a medida es justamente lo nuestro.
pie.en: Don't see your project here? Message us anyway: custom carpentry is exactly what we do.

items.quote: I'm so happy I found Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry. I have been needing a new wood mail box for a while and could not find anyone who did this work. I not only found someone I found an excellent craftsman. The work was done beautifully and quickly.

Excellent and creative carpentry. Roilan is very professional and dependable and completed all the work in a very short time. The work was very reasonably priced, and he presented the receipts for the materials provided.
It was a pleasure dealing with Roilán. He takes pride in a job well done, he is respectful, punctual, cleans up after his work and his prices are fair.
